name: otp
title: OTP
description: A short code typed one character to a slot.
use: A short code from a text message or an authenticator, where the product calls for one slot per character. Each slot is a native input; the script makes the slots one field to the hand.

instead.when: The phone fills the code from a text message, or no script may run: one field with autocomplete="one-time-code" takes the same code
The code is entered on a touch screen with keys drawn on the page

keyboard.action: Fills the slot and moves focus to the next one; a character the slot does not allow is refused
Clears the slot; in an empty slot, moves focus to the slot before and clears it
Move focus to the slot before or after; the other way around from right to left
Move focus to the first or the last slot
Spreads a pasted code across the slots: a whole code from the first slot, a part of one from the slot that has focus

classes.name: otp
classes.description: The group of slots, on a fieldset with a label

classes.name: otp-slot
classes.description: One character, on an input drawn as a small well; it has no visible label, so it needs a name such as "Digit 1"

classes.name: otp-separator
classes.description: A short dash between groups of slots, such as three and three; hide it with aria-hidden="true"

states.name: invalid
states.description: A danger contour on the slot; say why under the group

properties.name: --otp-width
properties.description: Slot width. On touch screens a slot is 2.75rem wide and the property is not read

properties.name: --otp-height
properties.description: Slot height. On touch screens a slot is 3rem tall and the property is not read

example:
<fieldset class="otp" aria-label="Verification code">
  <input class="otp-slot" inputmode="numeric" pattern="[0-9]" maxlength="1" autocomplete="one-time-code" aria-label="Digit 1">
  <input class="otp-slot" inputmode="numeric" pattern="[0-9]" maxlength="1" aria-label="Digit 2">
  <input class="otp-slot" inputmode="numeric" pattern="[0-9]" maxlength="1" aria-label="Digit 3">
  <input class="otp-slot" inputmode="numeric" pattern="[0-9]" maxlength="1" aria-label="Digit 4">
</fieldset>
